This plot is only 0.09 hectares — it is my small garden behind the house where I grow vegetables for eating and to sell a few at the market. I put manure there because I own the land and I keep cattle, so the dung costs me nothing; buying a full bag of fertilizer for this small place does not make sense when the agro-dealer only sells big bags. I use my own saved seed, I do not spray chemicals, and I do not irrigate because the rains in Mbeya are usually reliable. My wife and children help me weed and harvest, and we can manage all the work in about 12 days over the season, so I do not hire outside labor.
